inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2026 (year ended 30 Sep 2026) company guidance of 8 Aug 2026, raised twice from the original 880,000; 9M actual 709,272 (+12.2%) implies a Q4 of ~240,700 (+8.5%), so FY0 is three-quarters reported. FY2025 actual was 874,030.
inputs.share_count_basis: Debt-treatment fully diluted: 507.105m issued less 0.001m treasury at 30 Jun 2026 (Q3 FY2026 tanshin) + 2.68m stock acquisition rights = 509.8m. The 40,000 face convertible bond (26.54m shares at ~1,507 conversion price, FY2025 tanshin diluted-EPS note) is OUT OF THE MONEY at the price and at every scenario value below ~1,512, so it is carried as debt in net_debt and its shares are excluded; this is the more dilutive of the two treatments at the weighted value (the if-converted basis -- 536.4m shares, CB excluded, the 9M FY2026 diluted-EPS basis of 537.0m -- gave a weighted IV ~1.2% higher). Held FLAT: SBC is nil under J-GAAP. If a later update values the stock above ~1,512 the if-converted basis becomes the binding one and must be switched to.
inputs.net_debt_note: 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet: cash and deposits 212,081 less short-term borrowings 2,003, long-term borrowings 54,616 and the convertible bond 40,239 (total debt 96,858, ties to the CSV). CB carried as debt because it is out of the money (see share_count_basis). No lease liabilities exist under J-GAAP (operating leases expensed). NCI of 88,895 is NOT deducted here; it is charged through the combined leakage rate in cash_tax_rate_path.
inputs.sbc_source: J-GAAP cash flow statement carries no share-based payment add-back; the stock acquisition rights on the balance sheet (4,012 at Jun-2026) are paid-for options (1,050 proceeds in FY2025 financing). SBC held at 0% explicitly as its own line; house and street coincide.
inputs.buyback_note: No parent treasury-stock purchases in any year FY2020-FY2026 (cash flow statement 'Purchase of treasury stock (0)'). FY2025 did spend 9,746 buying treasury stock OF SUBSIDIARIES (raising the stake in Cygames et al.), which reduces future NCI leakage rather than the parent count. Flat count is a convention the company funds through nil SBC, not through buybacks.
inputs.last_fcf_note: last_fcf is FY2025 ACTUAL owner FCF (the last reported full year): reported FCF 51,741 (OCF 79,518 less capex 27,777 = 10,717 PP&E + 17,060 intangibles) less interest income 400, SBC nil. It was flattered by ~11,000 of tax timing (cash taxes 14,828 vs current tax expense 25,883; income taxes payable rose 9,709 -> 20,797 and reversed in H1 FY2026 when 18,643 was paid) and by ~3,500 of working-capital inflow. The component build does not carry that forward: FY2027 owner FCF is built from EBITDA -> D&A -> 46% combined leakage -> capex.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-built: 10y JGB ~1.6% (Oct 2026) + 6.0% Japan ERP x beta ~1.15 for a games/media/ad-agency mix = cost of equity ~8.5%; net-cash balance sheet so WACC = cost of equity, 8.5% in every scenario. Risk is charged ONCE: games hit-cycle, ABEMA margin durability and leadership transition are priced in the scenario flows and weights, not in a WACC premium or per-scenario WACC differences. Terminal growth 2.0% (Japan nominal GDP / inflation), terminal cap 15x FCF (cyclical, hit-driven earnings).
inputs.lease_treatment: None required: J-GAAP filer, operating leases are expensed inside operating income and no lease liabilities are recognised on the balance sheet; nothing is deducted from flows or added to net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Attributable-only flows via a COMBINED leakage rate in cash_tax_rate_path: 1 - (1 - 32% cash tax) x (1 - NCI share of profit). NCI share was 21.6% FY2024, 24.5% FY2025, 21.7% 9M FY2026 (Cygames and ABEMA minorities), and scales with the Games segment, so base 46%, bull 47.5%, bear 44%. Calibration: FY2026 guided OI 77,000 x (1 - 0.46) = 41,580 vs guided attributable net income 41,000. NCI book value 88,895 is therefore NOT deducted in the bridge (charging both would double-count).
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF DCF, component route, 10-year explicit build FY2027-FY2036 from an FY2026 guidance base. Chosen because CyberAgent is an operating company (internet advertising 49% of revenue, ABEMA media/IP 24%, games 27%) whose value is a stream of free cash flow; first valuation of this ticker, no memory entry. Non-US adaptations applied: JPY WACC, SBC-zero (band_position null), NCI charged once via leakage, interest income stripped with cash in the bridge, investment securities added net of deferred tax. Deliberately mid-cycle: Games segment profit (50.9bn in 9M FY2026, +44.8%) is at the top of its hit cycle (FY2022 60.5bn, FY2023 22.7bn, FY2024 30.6bn, FY2025 60.1bn), so base EBITDA margin steps DOWN from the FY2026 ~9.3% (9M 10.7%) to ~8.6%, i.e. the FY2022-FY2026 average; ABEMA's growth offsets a games normalisation rather than stacking on top of it. Historical FCF CAGR (17.6% 5yr) is a trough-to-peak figure and is not extrapolated. Price is the 30 Oct 2026 regular TSE close; FY2026 results are due mid-November 2026 and the FY2026 FY-end balance sheet should replace the June anchors then. Omitted from the bridge (conservative): operational investment securities 15,093 (CVC portfolio whose gains/losses already run through the Investment Development segment inside EBIT). CB treatment and its cross-check are in share_count_basis and valuation_philosophy.

equity_bridge.item: Investment securities (non-current, AFS cross-holdings) net of deferred tax on unrealised gains
equity_bridge.note: FY2025 tanshin balance sheet 46,298 at 30 Sep 2025; AFS valuation difference in AOCI fell 13,551 -> 9,818 by 30 Jun 2026 (~5,400 pre-tax), giving ~40,900, less ~4,400 deferred tax on the remaining unrealised gain. Matching-asset rule: dividend income (~630/yr) and interest income are outside the operating flows, so cash and these securities sit in the bridge.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: judgment: mid-cycle blend below the 3yr equity CAGR (8.1%) and 3yr revenue CAGR (7.2%); FY2027 growth of 5% assumes Games revenue flattens after the FY2026 +37.8% hit year while Advertising (+6%) and Media (+12%) continue
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS 5yr CAGR (37.0%) and FCF 5yr CAGR (17.6%) diverge >30% from the equity 5yr CAGR (15.0%) because FY2020 was a trough year (EPS 12.2, pre-Uma Musume); 3yr figures (equity 8.1%, revenue 7.2%, EPS 11.2%) are the better guide.
historical_growth.notes: CAGRs on FY2020 -> FY2025 and FY2022 -> FY2025 actuals (split-adjusted). Owner FCF series = reported FCF less interest income (SBC nil): FY2020 22,859; FY2021 97,008; FY2022 -8,283; FY2023 -4,942; FY2024 31,946; FY2025 51,341. The 3yr FCF CAGR is undefined (negative FY2022 base, the year of 45,298 cash taxes on FY2021's Uma Musume profits). FCF is far more volatile than equity because cash taxes lag profit by a year and games profit swings; the FY2021 peak (97,008) and the FY2022-FY2023 troughs bracket the hit cycle the scenarios model.

base.narrative: Mid-cycle. FY2027 revenue +5% as Games flattens after the FY2026 hit year, Advertising grows ~6% with the digital shift, Media & IP ~12%. EBITDA margin 8.8% -> 8.6% (operating margin ~7.4%): Games segment profit normalises from ~65bn toward 45-50bn, offset by ABEMA scaling from ~17bn to 25-30bn and Advertising holding 19-24bn, against corporate costs of 13-16bn. Capex 3.0% -> 2.5% of revenue (software, ABEMA content systems) with D&A catching up to 1.6%. Combined tax + NCI leakage 46% (32% cash tax, ~21% NCI).
base.da_note: D&A converges from the FY2026 ~1.2% of revenue toward the 2.5% terminal capex rate: J-GAAP amortises software over ~5 years and capex has run at 2.6-3.7% of revenue since FY2022 (software in progress 20.7bn at Sep-2025 not yet amortising), so holding D&A flat would understate the cash-tax shield at terminal. Impairments (5-6bn/yr FY2024-FY2025, extraordinary under J-GAAP) are not in EBITDA and partly offset the gap.

bull.narrative: Games sustains at the FY2026 level with new global titles replacing aging IP, ABEMA margins expand toward 12% on subscription/PPV/merchandising layers, and Advertising keeps share with AI products. EBITDA margin 9.6% -> 10.5% (operating margin ~9%), revenue +9% fading to 3%. Higher NCI leakage (47.5%) because the extra profit sits disproportionately in Cygames.
bull.da_note: D&A converges from the FY2026 ~1.2% of revenue toward the 2.5% terminal capex rate: J-GAAP amortises software over ~5 years and capex has run at 2.6-3.7% of revenue since FY2022 (software in progress 20.7bn at Sep-2025 not yet amortising), so holding D&A flat would understate the cash-tax shield at terminal. Impairments (5-6bn/yr FY2024-FY2025, extraordinary under J-GAAP) are not in EBITDA and partly offset the gap.

bear.narrative: The FY2023-type down-cycle repeats: Games revenue falls 15-20% as Uma Musume / Granblue / Shadowverse engagement fades and new launches miss, taking FY2027 consolidated revenue flat and segment profit to ~30bn; ABEMA stalls near 10bn as sports-rights and content inflation absorb the gains; Advertising margins stay compressed by client losses and AI investment. EBITDA margin 7.5% -> 6.5% (operating margin ~5%, the FY2024 level). Lower NCI leakage (44%) because the shortfall is in Cygames.
bear.da_note: D&A converges from the FY2026 ~1.2% of revenue toward the 2.5% terminal capex rate: J-GAAP amortises software over ~5 years and capex has run at 2.6-3.7% of revenue since FY2022 (software in progress 20.7bn at Sep-2025 not yet amortising), so holding D&A flat would understate the cash-tax shield at terminal. Impairments (5-6bn/yr FY2024-FY2025, extraordinary under J-GAAP) are not in EBITDA and partly offset the gap.

scenario_narratives.base: Mid-cycle blend: Games normalises from the FY2026 hit peak, ABEMA's newly profitable base scales to replace it, Advertising grows with the Japanese digital-ad shift. Revenue 5% -> 2.5%, EBITDA margin ~8.6% (the FY2022-FY2026 average), operating margin ~7.4%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Multi-layer IP strategy works: Games stays at the FY2026 level with new global hits, ABEMA margin reaches 12%, AI ad products hold Advertising share. Revenue 9% -> 3%, EBITDA margin to 10.5%.
scenario_narratives.bear: FY2023 repeats: flagship games fade and new launches miss, ABEMA profit stalls on content-cost inflation, Advertising margin stays compressed. Revenue flat in FY2027 then 2-2.5%, EBITDA margin to 6.5%.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear lifted from the 15% default to 25% because ~65% of segment profit comes from a hit-driven Games segment whose profit halved in FY2023 and whose core titles are aging, Media & IP profitability is one year old, and the first CEO change in 27 years is under way; no solvency risk (net cash ~115bn after the CB) keeps it from going higher. Bull cut to 25% because it needs two independent things to go right: Games sustaining its peak AND ABEMA margin expansion through a content-cost cycle.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value CyberAgent on attributable owner FCF at a mid-cycle margin, not on the FY2026 peak. The segment mix matters more than the consolidated line: the Advertising agency is low-margin but steady, ABEMA is a decade-long investment that has just turned profitable, and Cygames supplies most of the profit and most of the volatility, with a ~22% minority sharing it. Interest and dividend income are stripped and their source assets (cash, investment securities) added back once; NCI is charged once through the leakage rate; SBC is structurally nil under J-GAAP so house and street coincide.
valuation_philosophy.convertible_bond_treatment: Debt basis is binding: the CB is out of the money at the price and at the weighted value (< ~1,512 conversion price), so it sits in net debt and its 26.54m shares are excluded (509.8m shares). The if-converted alternative (536.4m shares, net debt -155,462) gave a weighted IV ~1.2% higher and only becomes the more dilutive basis above ~1,512/share.
key_risks_to_valuation: Games hit-cycle: a FY2023-style halving of Games segment profit is the bear case and carries 25% weight; the base already assumes a ~25% normalisation from FY2026
ABEMA margin durability through sports-rights and content-cost inflation; the base needs it to roughly double segment profit by FY2031
NCI leakage rate: each 1pp of NCI share is ~1.3% of value; the FY2025 subsidiary treasury-stock purchase (9,746) moves it the right way
Combined leakage assumes a 32% cash tax rate; FY2025's 39% current-tax rate was lifted by non-deductible impairments
Terminal value is capped at 15x FCF (Gordon at 8.5%/2.0% is 15.7x), so the cap binds and the valuation is not sensitive to terminal growth above 2%
June-2026 balance sheet and FY2026 guidance anchors should be replaced with FY2026 actuals in November 2026
